text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Canary alert: /v1/generate p95 latency and 5xx spike observed for canary group 'canary-72' starting ~09:05 UTC. Error rate 22% (baseline ~0.3%). Threshold crossed.

sara (oncall): ack. I'm on it. Can someone confirm rollout id and recent commits?

dean (release-eng): rollout id `rollout/2026-03-14-09:05/sha:a1b2c3d`. Canary-only changes include longer sequence allowance in config and slight kernel param tweak. Repro confirmed in canary.

eli (eng-sre): copying relevant log lines from gpu-pool-5:
```
2026-03-14T09:07:21Z ERROR model-infer : kv cache OOM, failed alloc 2.5G
runtime/kernel/decoder.cu:512
stack: GPU0: decoder_kernel(batch=48, seq=4096)
```

maria (cs): two customers reported 5xxs: acme-inc (pilot) and beta-svc. ACME escalated to SRE. Not full tenant outage but impacting requests.

sara (oncall): plan: 1) flip canary kill-switch (stop canary routing) 2) route traffic to stable variant 3) if errors persist, do quick revert/hotpatch 4) followup postmortem. Dean, can you toggle the flag? I'll coordinate comms.

dean (release-eng): doing now: `rdctl flags set rollout.canary-72 false --env production` -> executed. @deploy-bot confirm routing changes?

deploy-bot: Routing change accepted. Canary traffic diverted to stable pool, routing checksum `rch:45f2`.

el i (eng-sre): monitoring... error rate dropped to 1.1% within 120s. p95 latency back to baseline. Looks like routing change mitigated it.

sara (oncall): great. Maria please confirm with ACME that service restored. Also please open customer incident note.

maria (cs): pinged acme SREs, they confirmed success: "requests are succeeding now". Sending a short status update to them.

nick (pm): quick context: the canary enabled longer sequences for model evals only in canary group. Suspect memory pressure on decoder KV cache.

dean (release-eng): creating hotpatch branch `hotfix/decoder-kern-fix` and a revert PR for the canary config. If we need to ship quick patch, we can cherry-pick or revert commit `a1b2c3d`. Command I used locally:
```
git checkout -b hotfix/decoder-kern-fix
git revert --no-edit a1b2c3d
./scripts/deploy_smoke.sh --prod-targets stable
```
Smoke deploy passed in staging.

sara (oncall): handoff: I'll keep triaging for the next 15m then hand to @eli for longer monitoring. Eli ack?

eli (eng-sre): ack, I'll take the 2nd shift. I'll run a node-level audit on gpu-pool-5 and add memory guard checks to autoscaler.

dean (release-eng): pushed PR and queued a hotpatch canary to validate fix in staging. If stable remains healthy we'll delay re-enabling canary until fix is validated.

incident-bot: Incident note: mitigation applied: canary kill-switch toggled and traffic rerouted to stable variant. Severity: P2 (limited customer impact). Start: 1769004321. Mitigation timestamp: 1769004420. Assigned: sara (oncall), eli (eng-sre), dean (release-eng).

sara (oncall): action items for postmortem: (1) root cause hypothesis — canary-only config allowed sequences that exceed KV cache sizing causing OOMs in decoder kernel; (2) add memory guardrails and canary isolation; (3) enforce tighter canary runtime limits; (4) customer comms follow-up. Dean, file PR links + deploy logs in ticket.

maria (cs): drafting one-paragraph update for ACME and internal comms. Will attach timeline.

nick (pm): adding this to release blockers: pause canary expansion until hotpatch validated.

sara (oncall): closing thread after handoff to @eli. If error resurfaces or anything odd ping `@oncall` again.

eli (eng-sre): will monitor until end of shift and create support ticket if OOM repeats. Final note: peak error rate 22% -> 0.9% within 3m after kill-switch, no data loss detected. Leaving health checks running and will follow up with diagnostics artifact link in the ticket.
